It adds random noise to the input data.
It reduces the spatial dimensions of the input.
questions.explanation: Dropout randomly deactivates a fraction of neurons at each training step, which prevents co-adaptation of units and acts as regularization against overfitting.
questions.hint: Dropout = cho neuron 'nghỉ phép' ngẫu nhiên lúc train → chống overfitting. Drop = rụng neuron, không phải giảm kích thước hay thêm noise vào input.

questions.question: To reshape a vector v with length 12 into a 3x4 matrix in TensorFlow, which function should be used? (Choose 1 answer)
questions.explanation: tf.reshape changes the shape of a tensor while keeping the same number of elements, so tf.reshape(v, (3, 4)) turns a length-12 vector into a 3x4 matrix. The other functions do not exist for this purpose.
questions.hint: Đổi shape giữ nguyên số phần tử → tf.reshape(v, (3, 4)). Chỉ 'reshape' là hàm thật; resize/transform/matrixize đều là tên bịa.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the "ImageDataGenerator" in TensorFlow's Computer Vision applications? (Choose 1 answer)
options: Generating random numbers for image pixel values
Preprocessing image data for model training
Creating animated GIFs from image sequences
questions.explanation: ImageDataGenerator loads images in batches, rescales/normalizes them, and applies real-time data augmentation, i.e., it preprocesses image data to feed model training.
questions.hint: ImageDataGenerator không 'generate' ảnh từ hư không — nó TIỀN XỬ LÝ ảnh để feed vào training. 'Generator' ở đây = generator Python cấp batch.

questions.question: When exploring the impact of image compression in TensorFlow, what metric is commonly used to measure the trade-off between compression and image quality? (Choose 1 answer)
questions.explanation: Signal-to-Noise Ratio (and its variant PSNR) quantifies how much a compressed image deviates from the original, so it is the standard metric for the compression-versus-quality trade-off. Compression ratio alone measures size reduction, not quality.
questions.hint: Nén ảnh vs chất lượng → đo bằng Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR/PSNR). Bẫy chính: compression ratio chỉ đo độ nén, KHÔNG đo chất lượng.

questions.question: Which method within the Image Generator performs image normalization? (Choose 1 answer)
questions.explanation: ImageDataGenerator uses the rescale argument (e.g., rescale=1./255) to multiply pixel values and normalize them to the [0, 1] range; there is no normalize or rescale_image method.
questions.hint: Muốn normalize trong ImageDataGenerator phải gọi... rescale (rescale=1./255). Không tồn tại method 'normalize' — nhớ nghịch lý 'normalize tên là rescale'.

questions.question: What is stationarity in the context of time series data? (Choose 1 answer)
options: The presence of seasonality in the data
The constancy of statistical properties over time
The rapid changes in the time series
questions.explanation: A time series is stationary when its statistical properties (mean, variance, autocorrelation) remain constant over time.
questions.hint: Stationary = 'đứng yên' về mặt THỐNG KÊ: mean, variance, autocorrelation không đổi theo thời gian. Liên tưởng: station = trạm cố định.

questions.question: What is padding in the context of machine learning and TensorFlow? (Choose 1 answer)
options: A technique to remove unnecessary zeros from a dataset
Adding extra data to the input to ensure consistent dimensions
The process of smoothing out noisy data
Resizing images to a fixed size during preprocessing
questions.explanation: Padding adds extra values (typically zeros) to inputs, such as sequences or image borders, so that all inputs have consistent dimensions for batch processing or convolution operations.
questions.hint: Padding = 'độn thêm' (thường là số 0) để mọi input CÙNG kích thước. Pad = miếng đệm — THÊM vào, không bao giờ bớt đi.

questions.question: How can you visualize time series data effectively? (Choose 1 answer)
questions.explanation: Line charts plot values against time in order, making trends, seasonality, and patterns over time easy to see, which is why they are the standard choice for time series visualization.
questions.hint: Time series → LINE chart: nối các điểm theo thời gian mới thấy trend/seasonality. Khẩu quyết 'thời gian là một đường (line)'.

questions.question: How can you compile a sequential model with LSTM layers for classification in TensorFlow? (Choose 1 answer)
questions.explanation: compile() is an instance method called on a model object, so you must first create the Sequential instance (tf.keras.Sequential()) and then call .compile() on it. The other options call compile on the class or on nonexistent functions.
questions.hint: compile() là method của INSTANCE: phải có cặp ngoặc tạo object trước — tf.keras.Sequential().compile(...). Nhớ 'ngoặc () trước, compile sau'.

questions.question: Which Python library is commonly used for plotting training and validation accuracies in the context of evaluating model performance? (Choose 1 answer)
questions.explanation: Matplotlib is the standard Python plotting library used to graph training and validation accuracy/loss curves from a model's history object.
questions.hint: Vẽ accuracy curve → Matplotlib — chữ 'plot' nằm ngay trong tên thư viện. Phân vai: NumPy tính, TensorFlow train, Matplotlib vẽ.

questions.question: How can increasing the amount of training data help prevent overfitting? (Choose 1 answer)
options: By making the training process slower
By introducing more noise into the model
By improving the model's generalization to new data
Increasing data size has no effect on overfitting
questions.explanation: More training data exposes the model to a broader range of examples, making it harder to memorize individual samples and improving its ability to generalize to unseen data.
questions.hint: Câu sinh đôi với câu 'tăng data chống overfit': đáp án luôn là improving GENERALIZATION. Đông mẫu → hết học vẹt.

questions.question: Which statistical measure is commonly used to decompose a time series into trend, seasonality, and residual components? (Choose 1 answer)
questions.explanation: Classical time series decomposition estimates the trend component using moving averages, which is then removed to isolate the seasonal and residual components. MAD and MSE are error metrics, and ACF measures lag correlations rather than performing decomposition.
questions.hint: Decomposition cổ điển dùng MOVING AVERAGE để ước lượng trend rồi bóc tách phần còn lại. MAD/MSE là error metric, ACF chỉ đo lag correlation — loại cả ba.

questions.question: What is the purpose of using one-hot encoding for the target variable in a multi-class classification task? (Choose 1 answer)
options: To represent categorical labels as numerical vectors
One-hot encoding is not applicable for multi-class classification
questions.explanation: One-hot encoding converts each categorical class label into a binary vector with a 1 at the class index, giving the model a numerical representation compatible with losses like categorical crossentropy.
questions.hint: Mục đích one-hot: biến nhãn categorical thành VECTOR SỐ (một số 1 tại đúng lớp). Không phải để tăng complexity hay tăng tốc.

questions.question: What does the tokenize method of the BertTokenizer return? (Choose 1 answer)
options: A list of tokens obtained from the text
A tokenized sequence in a matrix form
questions.explanation: BertTokenizer.tokenize() splits the input text into WordPiece subword tokens and returns them as a list of strings; converting tokens to numeric indices requires a separate call such as convert_tokens_to_ids().
questions.hint: BertTokenizer.tokenize() trả LIST TOKEN dạng chuỗi; muốn ra SỐ phải gọi thêm convert_tokens_to_ids. Nhớ 'tokenize cho chữ, convert cho số'.

questions.question: What is the role of hyperparameter tuning in time series forecasting using machine learning? (Choose 1 answer)
options: To select the appropriate lag values
To optimize the learning rate of the model
To find the best model architecture
To identify the optimal time period for analysis
questions.explanation: Hyperparameter tuning searches over training settings such as the learning rate to find values that give the best model performance; the learning rate is the classic example of a hyperparameter tuned in ML-based forecasting.
questions.hint: Hyperparameter tuning trong forecasting: ví dụ kinh điển là chỉnh LEARNING RATE. Nhớ 'learning rate = hyperparameter số 1 trong sách giáo khoa'.
questions.review: Đề thi FE, không có đáp án chính thức; "lag values" cũng là lựa chọn hợp lý.

questions.question: What is the primary challenge in analyzing time series data? (Choose 1 answer)
questions.explanation: Time series observations are ordered and correlated over time, so models must capture these temporal dependencies (trend, seasonality, autocorrelation), which is the defining challenge of time series analysis.
questions.hint: Thách thức đặc trưng của time series nằm ngay trong chữ TIME: TEMPORAL dependencies. Thấy đáp án có chữ 'temporal' là chọn.

questions.question: What is the significance of convergence? (Choose 1 answer)
options: The process of getting very close to the correct answer.
An analysis that corresponds too closely or exactly to a particular set of data.
questions.explanation: Convergence in training means the optimization process approaches a stable solution where the loss stops decreasing significantly, i.e., the model gets very close to the correct answer. Option D describes overfitting instead.
questions.hint: Convergence = 'hội tụ' dần về đáp án đúng, loss ổn định. Bẫy: 'corresponds too closely to a particular set of data' là định nghĩa của OVERFITTING, đừng chọn.

questions.question: Which of the following is a common transformation applied during image data augmentation? (Choose 1 answer)
questions.explanation: Data augmentation creates varied training samples through random transformations such as rotation, flipping, and zooming; random rotation is a standard augmentation, whereas normalization and compression are preprocessing steps, not augmentations.
questions.hint: Augmentation = biến đổi NGẪU NHIÊN tạo mẫu mới: random rotation, flip, zoom. Normalization/compression/grayscale là preprocessing — không phải augmentation.

questions.question: What happens if the num_words parameter is set in the Tokenizer class? (Choose 1 answer)
options: It controls the learning rate during training.
It limits the vocabulary size to a specified number of words.
questions.explanation: In Keras' Tokenizer, num_words caps the vocabulary at the most frequent num_words-1 words; less frequent words are ignored when converting texts to sequences.
questions.hint: Tên tham số tự giải nghĩa: NUM_WORDS = số từ tối đa được giữ → giới hạn vocabulary theo tần suất. OOV token là tham số oov_token riêng.

questions.question: What is the result of adding two vectors of the same dimension in TensorFlow? (Choose 1 answer)
questions.explanation: Element-wise addition of two vectors with the same shape produces another vector of that same shape; the rank of the tensor does not change.
questions.hint: Vector + vector cùng chiều = VECTOR cùng chiều (cộng element-wise). Phép cộng không 'thăng cấp' rank tensor — không thành matrix hay scalar.

questions.question: What role does the base model play when creating a new model with a pre-trained base in TensorFlow? (Choose 1 answer)
options: It serves as the output layer of the new model
It replaces the need for custom layers in the new model
It initializes the weights of the entire new model
It acts as a feature extractor for the new model
questions.explanation: In transfer learning, the pre-trained base model (often frozen) extracts general features from the input, and new task-specific layers are added on top to perform the final classification.
questions.hint: Base model pre-trained = FEATURE EXTRACTOR: tầng dưới (đóng băng) rút đặc trưng, tầng mới phía trên lo phân loại. Nhớ 'base = thợ rút đặc trưng'.

questions.question: How does autocorrelation play a role in time series analysis? (Choose 1 answer)
options: It measures the correlation between different time series.
It helps identify patterns within a single time series at different lags.
It calculates the average correlation across multiple time series.
It assesses the correlation between time series and external factors.
questions.explanation: Autocorrelation measures the correlation of a time series with lagged copies of itself, revealing patterns such as seasonality and persistence within a single series at different lags.
questions.hint: AUTO-correlation = tự soi CHÍNH MÌNH ở các lag khác nhau — chỉ MỘT chuỗi duy nhất. Mọi đáp án nói 'giữa nhiều chuỗi/yếu tố ngoài' đều sai vì thiếu chữ 'auto'.

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of the ImageDataGenerator in TensorFlow? (Choose 1 answer)
options: Resizing images to a fixed dimension
Preprocessing and augmenting image data for model training
questions.explanation: ImageDataGenerator preprocesses image batches (e.g., rescaling) and applies real-time data augmentation such as rotations, shifts, and flips while feeding data to the model during training.
questions.hint: ImageDataGenerator = preprocess + AUGMENT — chọn đáp án đầy đủ cả hai vế. Không sinh ảnh synthetic, không load ảnh từ URL.

questions.question: Which deep learning architecture is commonly used for predicting the next word in a sequence? (Choose 1 answer)
questions.explanation: RNNs (including LSTM/GRU variants) process sequences step by step while maintaining a hidden state, making them the classic architecture for next-word prediction and language modeling.
questions.hint: Next-word prediction = bài toán CHUỖI → RNN (LSTM/GRU). Nhớ 'R = Recurrent = lặp theo thời gian, y như câu chữ nối tiếp nhau'.

questions.question: What does the rescale parameter in ImageDataGenerator do? (Choose 1 answer)
options: It resizes images to a specified shape.
It normalizes pixel values to a specified range.
It rotates images randomly during training.
questions.explanation: rescale multiplies every pixel value by the given factor (e.g., 1/255), normalizing pixel intensities from 0-255 to the 0-1 range; it does not change image dimensions.
questions.hint: rescale = NHÂN pixel với hệ số (1/255) để chuẩn hóa về [0,1] — đổi GIÁ TRỊ, không đổi KÍCH THƯỚC. Đừng nhầm reSCALE (giá trị) với reSIZE (kích thước).

questions.question: How does the lack of regularization contribute to overfitting in machine learning models? (Choose 1 answer)
options: Regularization has no impact on overfitting.
Lack of regularization allows the model to fit the training data too closely.
Regularization leads to underfitting rather than overfitting.
Lack of regularization increases the learning rate.
questions.explanation: Regularization penalizes model complexity; without it, the model is free to fit the training data too closely, including its noise, which is precisely what overfitting means.
questions.hint: Không có regularization = không ai 'ghì cương' → model bám training data quá sát, học cả noise. Regularization = dây cương chống overfit.

questions.question: How can you identify overfitting by examining a model's performance metrics? (Choose 1 answer)
options: If the training accuracy is high but the validation accuracy is low.
If both training and validation accuracies are high.
If the model has a low learning rate.
If the number of epochs is too small.
questions.explanation: A large gap where training accuracy is high but validation accuracy is low indicates the model has memorized the training data and fails to generalize, the hallmark of overfitting.
questions.hint: Dấu hiệu overfitting kinh điển: train accuracy CAO nhưng validation THẤP — 'giỏi lúc ôn ở nhà, dở khi đi thi'.

questions.question: What is the goal of sentiment analysis in text understanding? (Choose 1 answer)
options: Determining the emotional tone of the text
questions.explanation: Sentiment analysis classifies the emotional tone or polarity of text (e.g., positive, negative, neutral), not its grammar, general meaning, or summary.
questions.hint: Sentiment = cảm xúc: xác định EMOTIONAL TONE (tích cực/tiêu cực). Bẫy 'extracting meaning' nghe hay nhưng quá chung chung — đừng chọn.

questions.question: What does the F1 Score metric consider when evaluating the performance of a forecasting model? (Choose 1 answer)
options: The balance between precision and recall
The ratio of true positive predictions to total predicted positives
The overall accuracy of the model
The correlation between predicted and actual values
questions.explanation: The F1 Score is the harmonic mean of precision and recall, balancing the two; option B describes precision alone.
questions.hint: F1 = harmonic mean của Precision và Recall — cán cân BALANCE giữa hai. Bẫy: 'true positives / predicted positives' là định nghĩa của riêng Precision.

questions.question: How does reducing the complexity of a model contribute to preventing overfitting? (Choose 1 answer)
options: It increases the risk of overfitting.
It has no impact on overfitting.
It makes the model more prone to memorizing noise.
It encourages the model to capture general patterns rather than noise.
questions.explanation: A simpler model has less capacity to memorize noise in the training data, so it is forced to learn the general underlying patterns, which reduces overfitting.
questions.hint: Model đơn giản hơn = ít 'dung lượng' để học thuộc noise → buộc phải học GENERAL patterns. Khẩu quyết 'bớt phức tạp, bớt học vẹt'.

questions.question: How can you implement a learning rate schedule using callbacks in TensorFlow? (Choose 1 answer)
options: Learning rate schedules cannot be implemented with callbacks
questions.explanation: ReduceLROnPlateau is a Keras callback that adjusts (reduces) the learning rate during training when a monitored metric stops improving, effectively implementing a learning rate schedule. ModelCheckpoint saves weights and EarlyStopping halts training.
questions.hint: Callback chỉnh learning rate: ReduceLROnPlateau — 'giảm LR khi metric chững lại (plateau)'. Phân vai theo tên: ModelCheckpoint lưu weights, EarlyStopping dừng train.
